Onboarding,现在的样子

2026-09-19 从模拟器抽的,iOS plan-c-sealed 分支。每一步:截图 · 现在的文案(EN)· 逻辑 · 存了什么 · 代码在哪。给重新设计用,不做评价。

00 启动片01 门口 / 登录02 笔名03 称呼04 生日05 头像06 蛋壳07 喂蛋(写)08 读你(仪式)09 破壳10 起名11 第一次飞行12 到达 Today
顺序 launch → welcome → username → you → cakeday → avatar → egg → write → hatch(reading → born)→ naming → flight → Today
进度条 7 段(username…write),hatch 起没有进度、没有返回。孵化器牌(INCUBATOR + 状态句)只在 username / you / cakeday / avatar 四步出现,是"蛋在等你"的暗线。
登录 Apple / Google / 邮箱六位码,或 Just looking → 游客(匿名 session);游客走完全程,写信/回信到发送那一刻才被要求注册。
时长 启动片约 4.5s(2.2×)· 读你仪式 (喂的条数+3)×1.35s · 第一次飞行 3.05s,可点跳过。
00

启动片 · Launch

app/index.tsx · components/LaunchAnimation.tsx

文案(EN,当前)

(没有文案,只有 wordmark)
Kindredly
find your kindred spirits
SLOWLY, BY WRITING

逻辑

  • components/LaunchAnimation.tsx,按他的合成稿逐拍做的,CUES Ink/Egg/Crack/Hatch/Flight/Mark
  • 鸟固定用 Sky 皮肤(启动时读不到用户设置)
  • 放完后 app/index.tsx 判断:游客或没 onboard → /onboarding;否则 → Today

存了什么

  • 什么都不存
01

门口 / 登录 · Welcome

app/onboarding.tsx step=welcome

文案(EN,当前)

窗口标题 KINDREDLY.EXE

卡 1 · WRITE IT DOWN
Write down what's real.
Tired, glad, or just true — a line is enough.

卡 2 · OFF IT GOES
It finds your kind of person.
Matched by how you write — not by who you are.

卡 3 · THEY WRITE BACK
And slowly, you're not strangers.
Five letters each, and you trade names.

Continue with Apple / Continue with Google / Continue with email
邮箱展开:you@somewhere.com · Send me a code · We'll email you a six-digit code.
Just looking →
BY CONTINUING YOU AGREE TO THE TERMS & PRIVACY POLICY

逻辑

  • 三张卡 = 产品三句话(写 / 匹配 / 五封换名字),Y2K 控制台风格(theme/y2k)
  • 邮箱 → 六位码页(ob.code.*),链接也能用
  • Just looking → = 匿名登录,直接进笔名
  • 已登录但没 onboard 的账号打开这页直接跳到笔名

存了什么

  • session(Apple/Google/邮箱/匿名)
02

笔名 · Username

step=username

文案(EN,当前)

Pick a pen name.
Not your real name — change it anytime. Strangers never see it; you are how you write.
占位:robin

INCUBATOR · SOMETHING'S IN HERE.
NEXT ›

逻辑

  • 有字就能 NEXT(handle.length > 0)
  • 输入框用 GlyphInput(•> 光标)
  • 底部孵化器牌:蛋 + 状态句 + 三个呼吸点,从这步到头像一直在

存了什么

  • handle(本地 profile;登录用户之后随 profile 同步)

06

蛋壳 · Egg

step=egg

文案(EN,当前)

Pick your courier's shell.
Your words decide what hatches. The shell only leaves a birthmark — the bird inside is written, not chosen.
LV.0 · UNMATCHED
壳名:Moonstone …(四种)
THIS ONE'S MINE ›

  • 四个壳色只决定蛋和幼鸟的'胎记'(eggVar),不决定鸟是谁

存了什么

07

喂蛋(写)· Write

step=write

文案(EN,当前)

顶栏:FEED THE EGG · ▭▭▭▭▭ HUNGRY → n FED ✓
Give it something only you'd write.
One thought is enough to hatch. Each extra one locks in more of who comes out.

占位(按第几条换):
1 i keep rehearsing conversations i will never have
2 something you noticed today that nobody else did…
3 a small thing you remember for no reason…
4 the thing you almost said out loud…
5 one more, if it's already on your tongue…

FEED ↑ · HOW IT FEELS(九张 mood 脸)
按钮:FEED ONE THOUGHT FIRST → HATCH IT 🥚

逻辑

  • ≥2 个字就能 FEED,最多 5 条;喂 1 条就能 HATCH
  • mood 脸是可选的,决定第一封信的邮票(starterStamp:in-love/shy→crush,delighted/cheerful/excited→growing,sleepy/nervous/drained→can't sleep,heartbroken/crying/numb→miss someone,其余→ordinary)
  • 喂的每一条 = corpus,是引擎读你的全部材料;最长的一条会作为你的第一封信寄进池子
  • 每条可以 × 删掉

存了什么

  • thoughts[](内存)· mood
08

读你(仪式)· Reading

step=hatch · hatchPhase=crack

文案(EN,当前)

Reading you right now.
Don't close it. This takes about ten seconds.

清单:THOUGHT 01 READ … THOUGHT 0n READ · FINDING RHYTHM… · SHAPING VOICE · WAKING SOMETHING
WHAT YOU FED ME(列表)
进度 % · HATCHING…

逻辑

  • 这就是他要重做的那一段:喂满 → HATCH IT → 这页 → 深色'Something hatched'
  • 引擎其实一瞬间读完;仪式是故意拉长的:(条数+3) 个 tick × 1.35s,喂 5 条约 11s
  • 没有交互,不能跳过
  • W38 稿要换成:蛋自己三段裂开(抖动 + 透光)→ 六片壳带重力飞散,下三片落成壳窝 → 鸟可点(身体随机反应 / 头出爱心 / 壳低头看),CTA 按下扑翅

存了什么

  • hatched = hatch(corpus)(九维 + archetype)· hatchlingForm(dims)
09

破壳 · Born

step=hatch · hatchPhase=born

文案(EN,当前)

Something hatched.
It picked up something in your words.
标签:WAY OF SEEING / THOUGHT PATTERNS / …(九维里最先锁定的那一维)
STILL LEARNING.
GIVE IT A NAME ›

逻辑

  • 幼鸟的形态(hatchlingForm)由喂的字算出来,不是选的
  • 只给一张维度标签,不给分数、不给称号;称号要写到 10 封信之后
  • 标签名来自 ob.sealed.*:sentence shape / rare words / way of seeing / hidden rhythm / small tells / where you pause / thought patterns / emotional patterns / personal patterns

存了什么

  • hatched.archetype.id(kindredly_hatch_archetype)· hatchling form
10

起名 · Naming

step=naming

文案(EN,当前)

Your courier needs a name.
This is what they're called from here on — in every line they ever write you.
占位:Wren
候选:WREN · PIP · JUNO · MOTH · SABLE · OTIS · 🎲
AND THEY GO BY / AND {{name}} GOES BY:she / her · he / him · they / them
FIRST FLIGHT ›

逻辑

  • 有名字才能继续;骰子随机一个
  • 信使代词默认 she/her
  • 这一步同时在后台拉池子里的 40 封信(fetchPool),给下一步的航线图当'站点'

存了什么

  • her(kindredly_wren_name)· birdPro(kindredly_wren_pronoun)
11

第一次飞行 · Flight

step=flight · components/FirstFlight.tsx

文案(EN,当前)

{{name}}'s first flight.
YOUR WORDS, FOLDED INTO A LETTER
卡片:你喂的最长一条 · CARRIED BY {{NAME}}
LET {{name}} GO ›

飞行中:AIRMAIL ROUTE CHART · FIRST CROSSING · YOUR CITY · STOP n · TAP TO SKIP

逻辑

  • 按 LET GO 那一刻,后台 finish():把最长那条作为第一封信寄进池子(邮票按 mood)、上传写作指纹、存 profile / 幼鸟 / 蛋 / 名字 / 代词
  • 飞行 3.05s,FirstFlight.tsx;点一下跳过;Reduce Motion 直接跳
  • 飞完 onFlightDone:置 TODAY_RITUAL / ARRIVAL_FRESH 标记 → Today
  • 09-19 修的 bug:登录用户 profile 一存回来就被'已 onboard 重定向'踢到 Today,飞行被截断

存了什么

  • letters 表一行(你的第一封)· fingerprints · profile(onboarded: true)
12

到达 Today · Arrival

app/(tabs)/letters.tsx · Arrival

文案(EN,当前)

Your letter is on its way. I brought back three.
(三个信封图标)

逻辑

  • 三封 = 航线图上那三站,同一份缓存(POOL_CACHE_KEY),所以 Today 一开就有信
  • 到达条只出现一次(ARRIVAL_FRESH),之后就是普通 Today

存了什么

  • kindredly_flags: todayRitual / arrivalFresh · ARRIVAL_AT_KEY
